intro.text: A darkeyed soldier in Amaram's army and one of the four survivors of Kaladin's squad after a Shardbearer's attack.

items.text: Alabet survived with Hab, Reesh and Coreb when a Shardbearer attacked their squad. Kaladin killed the Shardbearer but refused the Shards.
When Amaram betrayed Kaladin, Alabet and Hab drew their knives, but Amaram's guards cut Alabet down.
